title: 6.1 Is there a bakery near here?
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson_title: Is there a bakery near here?
sub_lesson_title: Is there a bakery near here?
goal: Name four more places in town and ask whether one is near (Is there a bakery near here? Yes, there's one on Park Street.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.1 Places Around Town: A1 names useful places; A1+ 6.1 adds four more and asks whether one is near. The new items are bakery, bookstore, police station and gas station, the phrase near here after 4.4's Is there…? (Is there a bakery near here?) and the answer there's one + where it is (Yes, there's one on Park Street.), with 4.4's No, there isn't. Each new place is a photo whose window, car or pump shows what it is without any sign. A Yes answer is shown with that place; a No answer only with A1's shopping street, which has no gas station and no police station.
prerequisite: A1 6.1 places; A1 3.13 streets; A1+ 4.4 Is there…? and short answers.
speaking_outcome: Stress the place: BAKE-ry, BOOK-store, po-LICE sta-tion, GAS sta-tion; link there's one (therz-WUN). Do not require native-like speed.
